claim.text: With a_{t,i} as in note 1, R_{a_t} (the time-dependent Bregman potential) and the mirror-flow identity as in note 2 give the schedule α_t direct control over the scale a_t, over the global minimum of R_{a_t} as in note 3, and over the asymptotic implicit-bias strength as in note 4.
The schedule α_t controls the strength and position of the implicit bias.

note.text: elaboration of a_{t,i}: =2u_{0,i}v_{0,i} exp(-2 ∫_0^t α_s ds)
elaboration of global minimum of R_{a_t}: (at x = exp(-2 ∫_0^t α_s ds) ⊙ m_0 ⊙ w_0)
elaboration of asymptotic implicit-bias strength: (R_a(x) ~ log(1/a) ||x||_{L_1} as a→0 and |x/a|→∞)
